title: Application Engineer: Senior Staff Engineer / Staff Engineer / Senior Engineer
description: Description Responsibilities: As an Application engineer for CIS, you will be responsible to: Conduct analytic studies of fundamental performance issues for CIS or ISP and provide technical suggestions of improvement Support customer and solve their issue with close communication and lead the product to mass production Work with analog/digital design team to differentiate the performance of the product in the industry Simulate and analyze the image quality improvement of the product with new imaging algorithm Develop scientific approaches for image sensor/camera system’s performances Conduct modeling and simulation of imaging systems Requirements 5 + year application engineering / related experience is required Must have experience/knowledge in CMOS sensor or camera ISP system Must have someprogramming skills (VB, C/C++ , Python, Matlab, C# and other language) Good communication and inter personal skills (English and Japanese: business level, Chinese skill is a plus) Experience/knowledge in image signal processing and color technology is a plus Experience/knowledge in optics is a plus PhD / MS / BS in Electrical / Electronic Engineering, or Computer Science and Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience Result oriented and embraced change behaviors
